'''Zhire''' ([[Hyam language|Hyam:]] Zhebzhi, [[Hausa language|Hausa:]] Kenyi)<ref>{{Cite book |last=Hayab |first=P. |year=2016 |title=Basic Hyam Grammar with Ethnographic Notes |publisher=Beltina Digital Press |location=[[Abuja]] |page=83 |isbn=978-978-95298-9-6}}</ref> is a poorly known [[Plateau languages|Plateau language]] of [[Nigeria]].<ref>{{Glottolog|zhir1238|Zhire}}</ref> A variety called ''Shang'' is relexified Zhire.
